policy: no invented thresholds; every entry carries source_kind + citation + quoted source; unavailable => PENDING with the named missing input

pcie_cem_spec.doc: PCI Express Card Electromechanical Specification, Rev 5.0 v1.0, 2021-06-09 (PCI-SIG)

P1.name: high-speed main-path directness / flow-through structure

citation.quoted: Flow-through layout P2P with Intel retimer common footprint; Figure 9-7 TI PCIe Riser Card
chip CENTRE; connectors on ONE edge aligned with the chip fan-out; RADIAL fan-out

P1.note: the earlier 1.6x route/straight ratio was a PLACEHOLDER (no spec or manufacturer defines a directness ratio) - it is REMOVED as a verdict; the ratio is still REPORTED as an SI reading. What IS sourced: a flow-through framework = device on the connector axis, between the connectors.
P1.machine_check: chip lateral offset from the HS-connector axis <= 0.15*H; chip x strictly between the westmost and eastmost HS connector; each HS connector on its own side

P2.name: length budget feasibility

citation.doc: PCI Express Card Electromechanical Specification, Rev 5.0 v1.0, 2021-06-09 (PCI-SIG)
citation.section: 4.7.9 Differential Data Trace Propagation Delay (Add-in Card)
citation.quoted: The propagation delay for an Add-in Card data trace from the edge-finger to the Receiver/Transmitter must not exceed 750 ps

citation.doc: PCI Express Card Electromechanical Specification, Rev 5.0 v1.0, 2021-06-09 (PCI-SIG)
citation.section: Table 4-8 (page 59) - FR-4 scale used for the conversion
citation.quoted: SA = 0.35 ns - Estimates about a 2-inch trace length delta on FR-4 boards

threshold.applies_to: the routed length of every HS net on a ROUTED board (unrouted candidate => PENDING)

P2.machine_check: max routed length over all HS nets <= max_trace_length_mm

P3.name: mechanical frame (mounting holes four-corner + edge clearance)
P3.machine_check: every mounting hole <= 3.0 mm (euclidean) from its nearest distinct board corner and >= 0.3 mm from the board edge

P4.name: congestion capacity (section supply >= demand)

threshold.rule: a section-wise capacity model is NOT in register; the WITNESS test is used instead
threshold.witness_rule: a completed routing for the declared HS net set exists at the declared stackup => capacity >= demand at every section (existence proof, no invented supply model)

P4.machine_check: routed board: every HS net has >=1 track segment and 0 unconnected => PASS (witness); unrouted candidate => PENDING

P5.name: thermal path / thermal budget

citation.quoted: O2 = 30x30mm Al heatsink + 1.0 C/W interface pad + ~2 m/s airflow (owner confirmed airflow); theta_JA_eff = theta_JC_top(6.5) + R_int(1.0) + theta_HS(3.5) = 11.0 C/W; Ta = 40.0 C; Tj_max = 120.0 C; four cases 91.7 / 106.0 / 103.8 / 117.0 C => all PASS (worst-case margin 3.0 C)

T1: measured Tj(U6) > 117.0 C (margin < 3.0 C) OR the O2 thermal path not implemented => open a new rev whose first action is to add the U6-domain GND via array until theta_JA_eff <= 9.5 C/W (margin >= 8 C); T2: if U6-domain geometry is revised for any other reason, add the array in the same rev
GND vias should be placed directly beneath the device ... improving thermal conductivity

threshold.check_scope: structural check (GND vias beneath the device, datasheet rule 5) = verdict part; the four-case Tj budget is recomputed from the DECLARED inputs (Ta/theta/P) and reported

P5.machine_check: count GND vias inside the device bounding box (>= 1) AND recompute Tj = Ta + P*theta_JA_eff for the four declared cases

P6.name: DFM minimum spacing
P6.machine_check: clearance violations from the chain kicad-cli DRC report == 0

P7.name: power / GND (decoupling proximity)

citation.quoted: Decoupling capacitors should be placed as close to the VCC pins as possible. Placing the decoupling capacitors directly underneath the device is recommended if the board design permits.

threshold.literal_check: >= 1 decoupling capacitor inside the device bounding box (datasheet: 'directly underneath ... recommended')
threshold.reported: min distance from a power-net capacitor to the device bbox edge; count of power-net capacitors in the vicinity
threshold.no_numeric_limit: the datasheet gives no mm limit ('as close as possible' / 'if the board design permits')

P7.machine_check: report (min cap distance to device bbox, vicinity count, caps-inside-device count)
P7.missing_input: a machine-readable per-cap -> power-pin mapping (SPEC pd.decoupling is a STRING) - without it the criterion cannot be turned into a verdict
P7.note: the datasheet's recommendation is conditional ('if the board design permits'), so 'not underneath' is a FINDING, not an automatic FAIL
